tail: Photorealistic photograph for a practical home how-to video, soft natural daylight. Adult hands, rolled-up sleeves of a burgundy cotton shirt, only hands and forearms in the frame, no head, no face. 16:9 landscape format. No text, no letters, no numbers, no brand names, no logos, no watermark.
